SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT '01_PO' AS DOC_NAME , CSTMR_ID , ORDR_NO , ORDR_SEQ FROM KEPMPSO06 WHERE CSTMR_ID IN ('KRKOLO0001C001','KRKOLO0002C001','KRKOLO0003C001') AND SND_CHK = 'N' AND PROCE_STATE_CD IN ('SS03') UNION SELECT '02_RS' AS DOC_NAME , GI03.CSTMR_ID , GI03.ORDR_NO , GI03.ORDR_SEQ FROM KEPMPSO06 SO06, KEPWMGI03 GI03 WHERE GI03.CSTMR_ID IN ('KRKOLO0001C001','KRKOLO0002C001','KRKOLO0003C001') AND GI03.SND_CHK = 'N' AND GI03.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND SO06.PROCE_STATE_CD IN ('SS03') AND SO06.CSTMR_ID = GI03.CSTMR_ID AND SO06.ORDR_NO = GI03.ORDR_NO AND SO06.ORDR_SEQ= GI03.ORDR_SEQ GROUP BY GI03.CSTMR_ID,GI03.ORDR_NO,GI03.ORDR_SEQ ORDER BY DOC_NAME,CSTMR_ID, ORDR_NO, ORDR_SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT DECODE(SO06.USE_CHK,'N','D','C') AS STATUS , SO06.IF_ORDR_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO , SUBSTR(SO06.IF_ORDR_SEQ,1,10) AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ1 , SO06.IF_ORDR_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ , GETALANCINFO(SO06.SPPLR_ID,'ALANC_NM') AS SELLER_NAME , (SELECT REPLACE(PHON_NO,'-','') FROM KEPCOUR01 WHERE ALANC_ID = SO06.SPPLR_ID AND USE_CHK = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1) AS SELLER_TELNO , (SELECT SUBSTRB(USR_NM,1,10) FROM KEPCOUR01 WHERE ALANC_ID = SO06.SPPLR_ID AND USE_CHK = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1) AS SELLER_PERSON_NAME , (SELECT MAX(DLVRY_PLAN_DATE) FROM KEPCON.KEPWMGI03 WHERE CSTMR_ID = SO06.CSTMR_ID AND ORDR_NO = SO06.ORDR_NO AND ORDR_SEQ= SO06.ORDR_SEQ) AS DS_DATE FROM KEPCON.KEPMPSO06 SO06 WHERE SO06.CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND SO06.ORDR_NO = '$G_RS.ORDR_NO$' AND SO06.ORDR_NO = '$G_RS.ORDR_NO$' ORDER BY SO06.CSTMR_ID, SO06.ORDR_NO, SO06.ORDR_SEQ
DECLARE
BEGIN
IF '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$'='01_PO' THEN UPDATE KEPMPSO06 SET SND_CHK = 'Y' , SND_DATM= SYSDATE WHERE CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND ORDR_NO = '$G_RS.ORDR_NO$' AND ORDR_SEQ = $G_RS.ORDR_SEQ$; ELSE UPDATE KEPWMGI03 SET SND_CHK = 'Y' , SND_DATM= SYSDATE WHERE CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND ORDR_NO = '$G_RS.ORDR_NO$' AND ORDR_SEQ = $G_RS.ORDR_SEQ$; END IF; END;
DECLARE
BEGIN
IF '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$'='01_PO' THEN UPDATE KEPMPSO06 SET SND_CHK = 'E' , SND_DATM= SYSDATE WHERE CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND ORDR_NO = '$G_RS.ORDR_NO$' AND ORDR_SEQ = $G_RS.ORDR_SEQ$; ELSE UPDATE KEPWMGI03 SET SND_CHK = 'E' , SND_DATM= SYSDATE WHERE CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND ORDR_NO = '$G_RS.ORDR_NO$' AND ORDR_SEQ = $G_RS.ORDR_SEQ$; END IF; END;
